Network-wide ad-blocking, parental protection, and encrypted DNS over HTTPS

📱 How to Configure Devices to Use AdGuard Home

  1. Whole-Home Router DNS: Open your home Wi-Fi router settings (e.g. 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.3.1). In DHCP / LAN DNS settings, enter your server's LAN IP: 10.3.2.105 (or 192.168.99.1). Every device on your home network will automatically block ads and trackers with 0 client configuration.
  2. Android Private DNS: Settings ➔ Network & Internet ➔ Private DNS. Enter your Tailscale node hostname or DNS profile to enjoy network-wide ad protection on cellular 4G/5G data outside home.
  3. Tailnet Global DNS (Zero-Config): In Tailscale Admin Console ➔ DNS ➔ Nameservers: Add 100.108.215.120 as a global nameserver and enable "Override local DNS". Every device on your Tailnet will filter ads worldwide.
